# StudyX

> > StudyX is an all-in-one AI study partner offering homework help, note-taking, flashcard generation, quiz creation, and AI writing tools to enhance student learning across all subjects.

StudyX provides free and premium AI-powered study tools accessible via web, mobile app, browser extension, and Discord. The platform leverages multiple AI models (GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro) to deliver step-by-step homework solutions, instant note generation from various media formats, and academic integrity tools like plagiarism detection and AI content identification.

## Key Topics

- Homework Help
- AI Tutoring
- Note-Taking

## Core Study Tools

- [AI Homework Helper](https://studyx.ai/ai-homework-helper): AI homework helper providing step-by-step solutions across all subjects with multiple AI models.
- [AI Note Taker](https://studyx.ai/ai-note-taker): AI note taker converts textbooks, videos, slides into organized notes instantly.
- [AI Lecture Note Taker](https://studyx.ai/ai-lecture-note-taker): Lecture note taker converts audio, video, transcripts into organized notes instantly.
- [AI Flashcard Maker](https://studyx.ai/ai-flashcard-maker): AI flashcard maker generates study cards from notes, PDFs, images for exam prep.
- [AI Quiz Generator](https://studyx.ai/ai-quiz-generator): AI quiz generator creates practice tests from study materials with instant explanations.

## Content Summarization Tools

- [AI PDF Summarizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-pdf-summarizer): PDF summarizer generates instant notes from uploaded PDFs in under 30 seconds.
- [AI Video Summarizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-video-summarizer): YouTube video summarizer creates organized notes from videos instantly.

## Writing & Academic Integrity Tools

- [AI Detector](https://studyx.ai/ai-detector): AI detector identifies AI-generated text from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini with no login.
- [AI Humanizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-humanizer): AI humanizer rewrites AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing.
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://studyx.ai/plagiarism-checker): Plagiarism checker scans writing for matching sources and originality signals.
- [AI Paraphraser](https://studyx.ai/ai-paraphraser): AI paraphraser rewrites text with improved clarity while preserving original meaning.

- [StudyX Home](https://studyx.ai): StudyX homepage showcasing AI study tools for homework, notes, flashcards, and test prep.
